```sql
WITH j AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           ol.order_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM orders o
      JOIN order_lines ol       ON ol.order_id = o.id
      JOIN product_variants pv  ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
agg AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           sum(quantity)         AS quantity,
           sum(line_total_cents) AS revenue_cents
      FROM j
     GROUP BY product_id
),
oc AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS order_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, order_id FROM j) d
     GROUP BY product_id
),
vc AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM j) d
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       oc.order_count,
       agg.quantity,
       agg.revenue_cents,
       vc.variant_count
  FROM agg
  JOIN oc ON oc.product_id = agg.product_id
  JOIN vc ON vc.product_id = agg.product_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = agg.product_id
 ORDER BY agg.quantity DESC, agg.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De joins en filters worden één keer uitgevoerd in een smalle CTE. De `count(DISTINCT)`-berekeningen gebeuren daarna op alleen id-kolommen via hash-aggregatie, in plaats van op een gesorteerde set van 113 bytes breed die naar schijf lekte. `products` wordt pas na de aggregatie gejoind, zodat de brede kolommen niet meer door de sort gaan. De uitvoerkolommen, hun types en de ORDER BY zijn ongewijzigd.
